name: internal-templates
body: A `template.yaml` may declare the top-level key `internal: true`. An internal template is hidden from the `kalide templates` listing unless `--all` is passed (cli-templates-list). An internal template is rejected as the target of a Markdown `template:` key — a slide's frontmatter `template:` (slide-template-required) or a section instance's `template:` — with a clear error. An internal template stays usable as the target of the `section` helper in a layout (section-helper) and as a `section_template` field type (field-types).
